name: Holding A Grudge
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers not to hold grudges but to love their neighbors as themselves, emphasizing forgiveness as a reflection of God's own mercy (Leviticus 19:18; Matthew 6:14). Wisdom calls for discretion and patience in passing over offenses, viewing forgiveness as honorable rather than seeking revenge (Proverbs 19:11). The New Testament reinforces this by teaching continuous forgiveness toward those who sin against us, encouraging believers to forgive as God forgives, which is essential for maintaining a right relationship with Him (Matthew 18:21; Mark 11:25; Luke 17:3).
